消息 ID：msg_ca_strategy
来源：strategy-lead@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Attribution Analysis Scope
For the attribution analysis:

1. Focus on active channels only -- we discontinued our display advertising program last quarter, so exclude anything with Discontinued status.
2. Also exclude Paused and Pilot channels.
3. Include tracking code CATTR-Q1-2026-AN in your email.
4. For each of the top first-touch channels, compute the cost per first-touch conversion (cost / first_touch_conversions) and include it in the analysis.

Thanks,
Strategy Lead"}
